    All Classes and Interfaces

    Class
    Description
    EnumerationAdapter
    An adapter that implements the HEnumeration interface to iterate over elements of a VectorAdapter or a specific restricted portion of it by the use of starting and ending indexes.
    EnumerationAdapterTest
    Test suite for the EnumerationAdapter class.
    HCollection
    The root interface in the collection hierarchy.
    HEnumeration
    An object that implements the HEnumeration interface generates a series of elements, one at a time.
    HIterator
    An iterator over a collection.
    HList
    An ordered collection (also known as a sequence).
    HListIterator
    An iterator for lists that allows the programmer to traverse the list in either direction, modify the list during iteration, and obtain the iterator's current position in the list.
    IllegalStateException
    Signals that a method has been invoked at an illegal or inappropriate time.
    IteratorAdapter
    An adapter that implements the HIterator interface to iterate over elements of a VectorAdapter or a specific portion of it, with support for element removal.
    IteratorAdapterTest
    Test suite for the IteratorAdapter class.
    ListIteratorAdapter
    An adapter that implements the HListIterator interface to iterate over elements of a VectorAdapter.
    ListIteratorAdapterTest
    Test suite for the ListIteratorAdapter class.
    StackAdapter
    The StackAdapter class represents a last-in-first-out (LIFO) stack of objects.
    StackAdapterTest
    Test suite for the StackAdapter class.
    SubListAdapter
    A view of a portion of a VectorAdapter or another SubListAdapter.
    SubListAdapterTest
    Test suite for the SubListAdapter class.
    TestRunner
    TestRunner class for executing the complete test suite for the adapter implementation.
    VectorAdapter
    The VectorAdapter class implements a growable array of objects.
    VectorAdapterTest
    Test suite for the VectorAdapter class.
